components.provenance: V2X-09 bounded civilization technology/utility core. Trade degree counts only explicitly active edges whose modeled settlement endpoints are active. Settlement, resource, trade-edge, region, polity, infrastructure-asset and history-proposal identities fail closed when missing or duplicated; no last-wins identity semantics are permitted.
V2X-09 bounded resource, facility, storage and logistics initialization over existing modeled civilization state.
V2X-09 deterministic extraction, transformation, consumption, logistics, accounting closure and typed environment-impact proposals. Cross-domain outputs never mutate planet or life state.
V2X-09 bounded coordination, legitimacy, centralization, scarcity-strain and institutional-transition scenario mechanisms; no universal sociological law claim.

V2X-09 causal city morphology and bounded render-plan descriptors. Every emitted spatial/render primitive declares PRESENTATION_ONLY and no physical geometry claim; ruins require state/history support.

V2X-09 public additive API plus deterministic route-failure envelopes. Failure analysis rejects duplicate input identities, excludes disabled/non-operational routes, carries input evidence-completeness explicitly, evaluates at most 16 candidate routes and 256 scenarios, and enforces one 50000-operation budget for the entire envelope. Results are topology/capacity witnesses only: no guaranteed flow substitution, physical transport geometry, canonical history or cross-domain mutation.

V2X-09 deterministic multi-stage production graph with direct allocation followed by residual widest-path logistics. Only explicitly active trade edges between active, evidence-backed modeled settlement endpoints can carry capacity; inactive, unknown or missing-endpoint routes remain visible disabled witnesses. Routing is bounded to 48 settlements, 96 routes, 47 simple-path hops, 1024 searches and 48000 reported operations; a reserve protects service/ledger closure under search-budget exhaustion. Production exposes state/economy evidence coverage and never treats missing modeled economy as zero. Per-edge capacity/accounting closure is preserved and no physical route geometry or shortest-physical-path claim is made.

V2X-09 aggregate scarcity, opportunity, migration-pressure and institution-response proposals over complete modeled evidence only. Missing or state/economy-conflicting settlement evidence remains null/explicit and cannot emit synthetic migration pressure. Institutions exclude incomplete members while exposing the exclusion. Physical infrastructure degradation may trigger REPAIR_PRIORITY; topology/isolation instead triggers NETWORK_ACCESS_OR_REDUNDANCY_PRIORITY. No persistent person, population, polity, planet, life or P4 authority is mutated.

V2X-09 causal urban-family and specialization model with history/infrastructure-backed evidence layers. Corridor degradation requires explicit MODELED_INFRASTRUCTURE_CONDITION evidence plus a source infrastructure ID; trade-only fallback cannot masquerade as archaeology or infrastructure remnant. Incomplete economic evidence produces MODEL_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE rather than fabricated stable/stressed state. Render cues remain PRESENTATION_ONLY and claim neither physical geometry nor empirical archaeology.

V2X-09 advanced composition with explicit evidence-completeness summary, globally bounded network resilience and infrastructure-only counterfactual recovery. Bridge detection is linear in the modeled graph; alternate bottleneck capacity uses a deterministic max-capacity heap under one 250000-operation resilience budget. Recovery requires active modeled endpoints, ROUTE_LOGISTICS, PUBLIC_WORKS and identified infrastructure assets; it holds the economy snapshot constant, is capped at 16 projected epochs and 5500000 reported submodel operations, and never claims canonical forecasting. Shared renderer composition remains convergence-owner work.
